info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Incident Management Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Opens an incident (priority derived from impact and urgency, SLA targets pending), updates it (the priority is re-derived), assigns, acknowledges (the response SLA is met), starts, holds with a reason, resumes, comments publicly and internally, resolves with a code and notes, reopens, resolves again and closes, and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves self-service: a REQUESTER files on their own behalf, sees only their own incidents and no internal notes, cannot work an incident or read its audit trail (403 ERR-INC-00403), and another tenant or another requester gets a 404. Negative cases cover validation, illegal transitions (409), closed incidents refusing change, tenant isolation and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files its own incidents under its own generated tenant id (incOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
info.name: IT Incident Management Service - Incident Lifecycle Suite
